To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The dynamic behavior of a pavement plate supported by a soil of inertia is different from the behavior of the pavement plate supported by an elastic half space; (2) The inertia of the soil has a considerable impact on the dynamic behavior of the pavement; (3) The dynamic behavior is influenced by the soil stiffness, the inertia of the subgrade, the thickness and the dimensions of the plate; (4) The deflection decreases when the inertia of subgrade is taken into account;
the deflection of a plate resting on an inertia soil is less than a plate resting on a Winkler type soil.
The dynamic response of a rigid pavement plate based on an inertial soil was investigated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamic response of the pavement plate resting on the soil, whose inertia is taken in account in the design by rational methods.
the dynamic behavior of the pavement plate with a soil whose inertia has been taken into account.
a dynamic model for the pavement system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the inertia of the subgrade is important in the design of pavement and should be included in the dynamic analysis of the pavement.
the dynamic response of the pavement plate is significantly affected by the inertia of the subgrade.
the inertia of the subgrade soil is an important factor that should be considered in pavement design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inertia of soil has a significant impact on the dynamic response of the plate and should be considered in pavement design.
the dynamic response of rigid pavements is affected by the soil inertia.
the dynamic response of the pavement is influenced by the inertia of the subgrade soil and this influence should be considered in the design of the pavement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inertia of the subgrade soil must be considered in pavement design by the rational method.
it provides a new way of modeling the subgrade of a pavement.
the inertia of the subgrade should be taken into account in pavement design by rational methods.
